name: ICDAR 2017 RCTW-17: Reading Chinese Text in the Wild
description: A large-scale benchmark for text detection and recognition in Chinese natural scenes, organized by CASIA and CVC UAB for the ICDAR 2017 Robust Reading Competition. Contains 12,263 natural scene and web images (8,034 train and 4,229 test) displaying street views, shop signs, billboards, menu boards, and indoor displays. Most images contain predominantly Chinese text, with polygon bounding box coordinates and character-level transcriptions for complex multi-oriented script.
